text.p: ValueVision International Inc, the third largest U.S. television home shopping network, said it completed its purchase of Montgomery Ward Direct, the catalog business of Montgomery Ward & Co Inc.
The business is expected to add about $70 million in annualized sales to ValueVision's revenues, which were $24.3 million in the second quarter, the company said.
ValueVision said it issued about 1.48 million new vested warrants, exercisable at $0.01 per share to Montgomery Ward, for the acquisition.

Following new agreements between the two firms, Montgomery Ward's potential ownership of ValueVision, on a fully diluted basis after the exercise of all warrants, would be about 6.5 million ValueVision common shares. That represents about 17 percent of shares outstanding, the company said.
